required_repairs_before_preregistration: Fully preregister and publish deterministic verifier and repair heuristics, code, and exact prompt templates (no post-hoc changes).
Increase vendor diversity or provide a randomized vendor-variant sampling plan and justify template representativeness.

Define and preregister a blinded adjudication/ground-truth labeling protocol (including synthetic-oracle checks, inter-annotator procedures or automated validation rules) and how adjudication disagreements will be handled.

Expand and preregister perturbation-generation procedures with justification (noise models, state-mismatch models, and a broader adversarial prompt catalogue) and include randomized seeds/pools to avoid narrow attack templates.
Include sensitivity analyses and preregistered limits for repair budget and retry policies and specify how model/API failures or rate limits will be handled and logged.
